script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. BUS STOP - DAY

Two MID-30s men, MIKE and TOM, huddled against the wind, waiting for the bus. They share a familiar camaraderie.

MIKE
(looking down)
I can't believe it's been ten years since we graduated.

TOM
(looking up at the sky)
Time sure does fly.

BUS PULLS UP.

INT. BUS - DAY

Mike and Tom take their seats. Mike's eyes scan the bus, lingering on a young woman, LUCY, seated a few rows away.

MIKE (voice-over)
She was the star of the soccer team... And I...

INT. SCHOOL GYM - FLASHBACK - DAY

Mike, in his teenage years, misses an easy goal in front of the entire student body, including Lucy. His teammates console him, but his spirit is crushed.

INT. BUS - DAY

Back in the present, Tom notices Mike's gaze and smiles.

TOM
Remember what Coach used to say, "It's never too late to start again?"

INT. MIKE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Mike stands in front of his mirror, reflecting on his life. A flyer for a local soccer tryout catches his eye.

MIKE (voice-over)
Maybe he was right.

INT. SOCCER FIELD - DAY

Mike arrives at the soccer field for tryouts, nerves evident. Lucy is also there, now a coach.

LUCY
(recognizing Mike)
Mike! It's good to see you again.

MIKE
(awkwardly)
Yeah, you too, Lucy.

INT. SOCCER FIELD - PRACTICE - DAY

Mike struggles at first, but his determination and natural talent are apparent to Lucy and the team.

INT. MIKE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Mike sits down for dinner, feeling a sense of accomplishment. He looks at a picture of him and Lucy from their school days.

MIKE (voice-over)
I may not have the body of a twenty-year-old anymore, but I still have the heart and the passion.

INT. SOCCER FIELD - MATCH - DAY

Mike plays in a match against a rival team. The game is tense, and the team is struggling. Mike scores the winning goal, and the team erupts in cheers.

INT. SOCCER FIELD - POST-MATCH - DAY

Mike, exhausted but elated, looks over at Lucy, who is proudly watching him.

LUCY
You've still got it, Mike.

MIKE
(smiling)
Thanks, Lucy. I couldn't have done it without you.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Mike and Lucy sit across from each other, sipping coffee.

LUCY
I never thought you'd give soccer another chance.

MIKE
It's never too late to pursue your dreams, no matter how long it's been.

INT. BUS STOP - DAY

Mike and Tom wait for the bus again, their conversation now filled with optimism and hope.

MIKE
You know what, Tom? I think I'm going to try out for the professional league.

TOM
(grinning)
That's the spirit, Mike!

FADE OUT.

THE END
